scope: SYNTHETIC ANALYTIC FIXTURE. Not NV topology, vendor data, measurements or simulation results.

topology.description: Single CDU zone, single rack with one equivalent server cold plate; one energy valve + one return tee + supply/return isolation valves, all fixed open. One equivalent pump and a two-fluid-volume HX (no vendor internal topology).

geometry.description: 6 x 4 x 3 m minimal room; generic construction shapes cloned from own Shinaide fixture; line lengths from the common geometry compiler.

thermal.description: UA_cp=100 W/K, C_solid=1000 J/K, V_fluid=2 L, UA_hx=500 W/K, baseline load 100 W, primary 0.1 kg/s at 290 K FIXED supply, primary/secondary mixed volumes 1 L / 2 L, water rho 997 / cp 4182. Chosen for analytic tractability (lumped linear thermal ODE with closed-form step response); secondary flow comes from the hydraulic solve and is asserted constant by the acceptance script.

missing: everything real: this fixture exists only to verify the transient DAE solver against a manufactured closed form
